source_title: Isolation of compound microsatellite markers for the endangered plant Neolitsea sericea (Lauraceae)
source_excerpt: Neolitsea sericea is dioecious, hence an obligate outcrosser, and does not reproduce vegetatively.
review_note: Original publisher full text re-read 2026-09-07. Explicit species-level outcrossing statement; not model inference from dioecy. Conservative existing ontology maps obligate outcrossing to predominantly_outcrossing. Natural-history citation points to Chung et al. 2000; upstream study not independently re-read. Count as one Medium lineage, never as two sources. Existing frozen species-trait and species-axis collisions absent. Genus retraining remains deferred.
